title: Terminal Berth
description: Once a shipment has actually arrived, calling "advance" on it again shouldn't send it anywhere else — delivered is the end of the line.
successCondition: Advance a shipment repeatedly until GET /api/tracking/:id shows status "delivered". Call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance one more time after that. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` confirms status is still exactly 'delivered' (not reverted, not errored into something else) and current_lat/current_lng still equal destination_lat/destination_lng — a call past delivery is a safe no-op at the DB level.
hints: ShipmentStatus has no state after "delivered" in the enum (prisma/schema.prisma) — the service layer's advance logic should simply stop moving/transitioning once it's reached.
Depending on distance, reaching "delivered" may take several /advance calls — keep calling until GET /api/tracking/:id confirms it before testing the extra call.
